payload.title: LERM applied to synthetic ODP cores
payload.description: This notebook applies the Linear Empirical Response Model (LERM) to synthetic Ocean Drilling Program (ODP) cores, specifically recreating Figure 3 from a referenced publication. The workflow involves loading and processing data from multiple ODP sites, handling discontinuities, and visualizing results using various plotting libraries.

steps.description: Define group lists for easy loading of ODP site data. Handle discontinuities in the data, specifically excluding a discontinuity in ODP 927 around 4000 ka.
steps.title: Define Group Lists and Handle Discontinuities
